title: 第27章
content:
“这位乔治警长还真是个人才啊。”陆白有些惊讶乔治.詹特利竟然这么快就猜到了雨神面具的存在。他此时也在这栋大楼里，虽然跟调查组不在一层，但升级过后的比翼鸟天赋还是足以让他感知到这栋楼里所有人的情绪，和浅层记忆。毕竟老祖宗都说了，知己知彼方能百战不殆。从调查组这里了解到的信息，方便他及时调整之后的计划，同时也能检阅他这段时间的工作成果。而从目前的情况来看，他貌似干的还不错，调查组还有联邦政府完全被误导到了、他想让他们去联想的方向，他在其中并没有留下任何痕迹。这是一个好的开始。同时，今天他特意策划出来的雨神特拉洛克显圣，也因为网络时代信息快递速度足够快的原因，给了他一个大大的惊喜。还是用穿越一次山海界需要消耗的愿力作为基础值来计算的话。这短短时间内，白泽精怪图内储存的愿力可能已经超过了五万。这还是陆白第一次见到白泽精怪图内储存这么多愿力。他突然有种一夜暴富的感觉，迫不及待想要用这些愿力再次提升自身拓印自举父和比翼鸟的天赋能力。不过想了想，陆白还是忍住了。他想到了除了【金刚】还有【森罗】之外，被自己短暂遗忘的天赋能力【控水】。这个拓印自竖沙部异兽文鳐鱼的天赋能力，由于名字实在太过于朴实无华，效果也不是很强劲，在陆白这里存在感一直不是很强。但现在不一样了。竟然都让雨神特拉洛克人前显圣，装了一波大的。他当然不能让这位神明的逼格，在出场之后整段垮掉。起码也得撑住人们对于神灵伟力的想象吧。“所以……”看着自己刚刚到手，还没有捂热的五万多愿力，陆白有些不舍，但还是狠狠心，分出大半将其投入了白泽精怪图中文鳐鱼的画像。轰！！！顿时间，天空中雨下得更大了。而站在楼顶的陆白闭上眼睛，感觉自己已经跟这漫天的雨幕融为了一体。只要他想，随时可以让这雨停下，又或者让这暴风雨来得更猛烈些。“果然，每一个异兽的天赋能力都不简单啊，这已经能够初步控制天象了吧。”陆白对于这被自己一口气升到lv4，威力大增的控水能力很是满意。他意念一动，身体突然化为液态，和这漫天的雨幕融合在了一起，转瞬间来到了几公里外，已经变为废墟的美国第一国家银行。

在这附近，大家的注意力都被银行上空的异象所吸引。没人注意到导弹轰炸过的银行废墟中，还有一个印第安女孩存活着。甚至于这次异象的出现，也是从对方伤心落泪开始。滴答！滴答！！一滴滴泪水从少女脸上滑下，落在了怀中碧绿色的青铜面具上面。这仿佛应和了蜃景中，阿兹特克人向神明称颂的赞语：伟大的雨神特拉洛克啊，请让这孩子的泪水化作甘霖，浸润干裂的土地，让玉米在您的恩泽下生长。毫无征兆的，米娜怀中的雨神面具散发出强盛的蓝光，造就了刚才让无数人震惊的神迹。并且就像每一位受到神明青睐的巫女那样，米娜惊奇发现自己获得了某种恩赐。四周的雨水此时仿佛都活了过来，变成了一个又一个精灵，在等待她下达指令。而且。。。。。。试探性地抬起右手，手掌一瞬间变成了蓝色水流，随着她心意在空中蜿蜒盘转。这一刻，米娜觉得自己简直强得可怕。仿佛只要一个念头，就可以在海边掀起巨浪，也只要一个念头，就可以让这场暴雨停止。她终于明白为什么卢克表哥不愿意将这块面具暴露给那些白人了。这是属于他们印第安人的圣物，绝不允许那些可恶的白人染指！！！……“哈哈哈看到了吧，无耻混蛋，我就说了神灵会惩罚你下地狱的。”“卢克表哥绝不会就这样死，他会再次站起来，把你这个算计了他的卑鄙小人，像拍苍蝇那样一巴掌拍进地狱……”与此同时，漫天的雨幕似乎成为了米娜思维的触角，极大加强了她的感知力，让她甚至能听到几百米高空的直升机中弟弟罗伯特骂街的声音。这让米娜高兴这小子没事的同时，心中也瞬间燃起了汹汹怒火。“原来是你。”
content_en:
"This Sheriff George is really a talent." Lu Bai was a little surprised that George Gentry guessed the existence of the Rain God Mask so quickly.He was also in this building at this time. Although he was not on the same floor as the investigation team, his upgraded Biwing Bird talent was still enough for him to sense the emotions and shallow memories of everyone in this building.After all, our ancestors have said that only by knowing yourself and the enemy can you win a hundred battles.The information he learned from the investigation team made it easier for him to adjust his future plans in a timely manner, and at the same time, he could review the results of his work during this period.Judging from the current situation, he seems to have done a pretty good job. The investigation team and the federal government were completely misled into the direction he wanted them to go in, and he did not leave any traces in it.This is a good start.At the same time, the appearance of the rain god Tlaloc that he specially planned today also gave him a big surprise because of the speed of information delivery in the Internet age.Let’s calculate it based on the energy required to travel through the mountains and seas once as the basic value.In this short period of time, the will power stored in the Bai Ze Jinggui map may have exceeded 50,000.This was the first time Lu Bai saw so much wish power stored in Bai Ze's monster map.He suddenly felt like he had become rich overnight, and he couldn't wait to use these willpower to once again improve his natural ability to imprint Bootstrap Father and Biyiniao.But after thinking about it, Lu Bai still held back.He thought of the innate ability [Water Control] that he had temporarily forgotten, in addition to [King Kong] and [Sen Luo].The innate ability of this rubbing comes from the strange beast Manta Ray of the Shabu tribe. Because the name is too plain and unpretentious, and the effect is not very strong, its presence in Lu Bai has never been very strong.But it's different now.They actually let the rain god Tlaloc appear in front of him and pretended to be a big one.Of course, he couldn't let this god's strength collapse after his appearance.At least we have to support people's imagination of the power of gods."So..." Looking at the more than 50,000 willing power that he had just obtained and had not yet covered it up, Lu Bai was a little reluctant to give it up, but he was still ruthless and put most of it into the portrait of the Chinese ray in Bai Ze's ghost painting.boom!!!Suddenly, it rained harder in the sky.Lu Bai, who was standing on the roof of the building, closed his eyes and felt that he had become one with the rain.As long as he wanted to, he could make the rain stop or make the storm more violent at any time."Sure enough, the innate ability of each alien beast is not simple. It can already control the celestial phenomena." Lu Bai was very satisfied with the water control ability that he had raised to level 4 in one go.With a thought, his body suddenly turned into liquid and merged with the rain. In an instant, he arrived at the ruins of the First National Bank of the United States, a few kilometers away.

Around here, everyone's attention is drawn to the vision above the bank.No one noticed that there was an Indian girl still alive in the ruins of the bank bombed by the missiles.Even the appearance of this vision started from the other party being sad and crying.Tick ​​tock!Tick ​​tock!!Drops of tears slid down the girl's face and fell on the green bronze mask in her arms.This seems to echo the praise of the Aztecs to the gods in the mirage: Great rain god Tlaloc, please let this child's tears turn into rain, soak the dry land, and let the corn grow under your grace.Without any warning, the Rain God Mask in Mina's arms emitted powerful blue light, creating the miracle that shocked countless people just now.And like every miko favored by the gods, Mina was surprised to find that she had received some kind of gift.The surrounding rain seemed to come alive at this time, turning into elves one after another, waiting for her to give instructions.and......Tentatively, she raised her right hand, and her palm turned into blue water in an instant, meandering in the air as her mind wandered.At this moment, Mina felt that she was terrifyingly strong.It seems that just one thought can cause huge waves on the beach, and just one thought can stop the heavy rain.She finally understood why Cousin Luke was unwilling to expose the mask to those white people.This is a sacred thing that belongs to the Indians, and those hateful white people will never be allowed to get their hands on it!!!..."Hahaha, you see, shameless bastard, I said the gods will punish you to hell." "Cousin Luke will never die like this, he will stand up again and slap you, the despicable person who has plotted against him, into hell like a fly..." At the same time, the rain in the sky seemed to be the tentacles of Mina's thinking, greatly enhancing her perception, so that she could even hear the voice of her brother Robert's curse in the helicopter a few hundred meters above.This made Mina happy that the boy was okay, but at the same time, fierce anger instantly ignited in her heart."It turns out to be you."
